steps.description: This is `word_count_server.py`, a small MCP server. MCP, the Model Context Protocol, is a standard way for an agent to discover and call tools. The page says to save this file as `word_count_server.py` in your project.
`from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP` imports `FastMCP`, the class that builds the server.
`mcp = FastMCP("word-tools")` creates the server and names it `word-tools`.
`@mcp.tool()` registers the function below as a tool. `word_count` takes `text` and returns an int, and its docstring, `Count the words in a piece of text.`, becomes the tool's description.
The `__main__` guard runs `mcp.run()`, which starts the server when you run the file directly.
